sections.2_observation_and_claim: Sixteen actual Ruby 3.1 builtin YARB containers are recoverable inert program material. Their full decoded bodies and caller/native wiring are new evidence, distinct from prior C-string program approvals. This is a reception correction, not an allegation that all runtime methods require new normative clauses.

4_ordinary_case_and_minimal_counterexamp.ordinary: Marshal.load wrapper supplies proc=nil and freeze:false, calls builtin marshal_load with three arguments; restore is an alias. pack/unpack and GC.start wrappers similarly retain explicit options.
4_ordinary_case_and_minimal_counterexamp.minimal_counterexample_to_blanket_opaque: nilclass_bin has executable ISEQs returning integer 0 and floating 0.0. Treating every YARB byte as opaque would hide this finite readable behavior.
4_ordinary_case_and_minimal_counterexamp.counterexample_to_overclaim: The wrapper reaching marshal_load does not prove actual deserialization succeeds, and an installed Ractor method is not evidence the default game calls it.

examples: Dir.open with a block has an ensure-close path, including exceptions.

gem_prelude catches LoadError with the recorded warning/reraise paths.
R plugin metadata and earlier scripts can remain before a later failure; no overall rollback is inferred.

6_formal_mapping_and_correctly_preserved.formal_gap_claim: No required new normative defect alleged in this child; native/host boundaries and default callers must constrain any later proposal.

7_minimal_change_and_regression.requested_action: Root assigns another actual context to verify the complete new program and decoder evidence, then decides reception and any concrete gap.
7_minimal_change_and_regression.static_regression: Exact raw SHA, 16 registry pointers/sizes, all 202 opcode table entries, 171 ISEQ decode closure, 115 builtin records and 120 matching builtin references.

sections.8_history_relationship: No reception credit borrowed from old 659 C strings, six new MJIT programs or the four root-rebutted GR8-BIN claims. Our remaining20907 set has no candidate identity overlap with those earlier complete program ranges; Game equal-text occurrences remain parent-owned.
